headline: Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle Flare as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, fresh territorial swings have erupted across Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle, each logging five base transfers in the past two hours as clashes flare over Briar, The Reach, and Trammel Pool. Weathered Expanse remains a tempest of attrition, suffering heavy mutual casualties with four strategic bases reduced to no-man's-land amid fierce struggles at Wightwalk and Crow's Nest. In Callahan's Passage, grinding combat persists with more than fifteen hundred combined casualties over two hours centered on Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. Meanwhile, the blistering turnover previously driving Nevish Line and Palantine Berm has quieted over the latest two-hour window, though both sectors remain heavily contested after dozens of day-long exchanges. Secondary friction continues in Mooring County and Linn of Mercy through elevated casualty counts, whereas rear-echelon territories across both north and south report negligible activity.
